betterquesting:10.desc:8: To progress further into Roots, you'll need a certain type of dust that can't be made normally, you need some Runic dust. For Runic dust you'll need some Baffle Cap Powder, Stone Dust, Flint Dust, and a heap of some Steel Dust. grind it all together in a Mortar, and you will have a powerfully magical dust with many unique properties.
